python:KeyError.title: Missing dictionary key
python:KeyError.plain: The code asked a dictionary for a key that is not in it.
causes: A typo in the key name
The data came from outside (a request, a file) without that field
The key was never added, or was removed earlier

python:IndexError.title: Position out of range
python:IndexError.plain: The code asked a list (or text) for a position that does not exist, for example item 10 of a list with 3 items.
causes: The list is empty
An off-by-one mistake in a loop or index
The list is shorter than expected

python:AttributeError.title: No such attribute
python:AttributeError.plain: The code used a name after a dot (like user.email) that this object does not have.
causes: The value is None instead of the expected object
A typo in the attribute or method name
The object is of a different type than expected

python:TypeError.title: Wrong kind of value
python:TypeError.plain: An operation got a value of the wrong type, like adding a number to text or calling something that is not a function.
causes: Mixing text and numbers
Passing the wrong number of arguments to a function
A value is None where an object was expected

python:ValueError.title: Right type, bad value
python:ValueError.plain: A function got a value of the right type but with content it cannot use, like int("abc").
causes: Text that is not a valid number or date
Unpacking a different number of items than expected
Input that was not checked before use

python:NameError.title: Unknown name
python:NameError.plain: The code used a variable or function name that has not been defined at that point.
causes: A typo in the name
A missing import
The variable is only set in some branches of an if

python:ImportError.title: Import failed
python:ImportError.plain: Python found the module but could not import the name asked for from it.
causes: The name was renamed or removed in that module
Two modules import each other (a circular import)
A different version of the package is installed

python:ModuleNotFoundError.title: Module not found
python:ModuleNotFoundError.plain: Python could not find a module with that name.
causes: The package is not installed in this environment
A typo in the module name
The program is started from a different folder than expected

python:ZeroDivisionError.title: Division by zero
python:ZeroDivisionError.plain: The code divided a number by zero.
causes: A count or total that can be zero (for example an empty list)
Missing check before dividing

python:FileNotFoundError.title: File not found
python:FileNotFoundError.plain: The program tried to open a file or folder that does not exist.
causes: A wrong or relative path
The program runs from a different folder
The file was not created yet or was deleted

python:RecursionError.title: Too many nested calls
python:RecursionError.plain: A function kept calling itself (directly or through others) until Python stopped it.
causes: A recursive function without a correct stop condition
Two functions calling each other forever

python:AssertionError.title: A check failed
python:AssertionError.plain: An assert statement found that something the code expected to be true was false.
causes: A bug earlier produced unexpected data
The assumption in the assert is no longer valid

javascript:TypeError.title: Wrong kind of value
javascript:TypeError.plain: The code used a value in a way its type does not allow, most often reading a property of undefined or null.
causes: A variable is undefined or null
Calling something that is not a function
Data arrived in a different shape than expected

javascript:ReferenceError.title: Unknown name
javascript:ReferenceError.plain: The code used a variable that does not exist in that place.
causes: A typo in the name
A missing import
Using a variable before it is declared

javascript:RangeError.title: Value out of range
javascript:RangeError.plain: A value was outside the allowed range, or functions called each other too deeply.
causes: Endless recursion ("Maximum call stack size exceeded")
An invalid array length or number format

javascript:SyntaxError.title: Invalid code or data
javascript:SyntaxError.plain: The code, or text parsed as JSON, is not written correctly.
causes: Parsing a response that is not valid JSON (often an HTML error page)
A typo in the code that the build did not catch

java:java.lang.NullPointerException.title: Used a null value
java:java.lang.NullPointerException.plain: The code used an object reference that points to nothing (null).
causes: A method returned null
A field was never set
A map lookup found no value

java:java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsExce.title: Position out of range
java:java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsExce.plain: The code asked an array for a position that does not exist.
causes: An off-by-one mistake in a loop
The array is shorter than expected

java:java.lang.ClassCastException.title: Wrong type conversion
java:java.lang.ClassCastException.plain: The code tried to treat an object as a type it is not.
causes: A collection holds objects of mixed types
A wrong assumption about what a method returns

java:java.lang.IllegalArgumentException.title: Bad argument
java:java.lang.IllegalArgumentException.plain: A method was given an argument it does not accept.
causes: Input that was not checked before use
A value out of the allowed range

java:java.lang.IllegalStateException.title: Wrong moment
java:java.lang.IllegalStateException.plain: A method was called when the object was not in a state that allows it.
causes: Calling methods in the wrong order
Using something after it was closed or before it was started

go:panic.title: Program panic
go:panic.plain: The Go program hit an error it could not continue from and stopped.
causes: Using a nil pointer or map
An index out of range
An explicit panic() in the code

csharp:System.NullReferenceException.title: Used a null value
csharp:System.NullReferenceException.plain: The code used an object reference that points to nothing (null).
causes: A method returned null
A property was never set
A lookup found nothing

csharp:System.ArgumentException.title: Bad argument
csharp:System.ArgumentException.plain: A method was given an argument it does not accept.
causes: Input that was not checked before use
A value in the wrong format

csharp:System.InvalidOperationException.title: Wrong moment
csharp:System.InvalidOperationException.plain: A method was called when the object was not in a state that allows it.
causes: Changing a collection while looping over it
Calling methods in the wrong order

csharp:System.IndexOutOfRangeException.title: Position out of range
csharp:System.IndexOutOfRangeException.plain: The code asked an array for a position that does not exist.
causes: An off-by-one mistake in a loop
The array is shorter than expected
